resources.string: Talk wit AI for private, like phone call.
Puzru Mini controller. Status: %1$s. Turn am on, expand, and close controls.

Puzru no need account or sign-in, and e no dey ask for microphone permission. E no dey capture or record microphone audio, and e no dey record or store your conversation or di audio content inside am.

Puzru dey use Android audio-system information wey e need for audio routing and diagnostics. Diagnostics fit check technical state and metadata wey public Android APIs show, including playback and recording-session metadata. Recording-session metadata na technical audio-system information; Puzru no dey capture di microphone audio wey join those sessions. Diagnostic information fit include app and Android versions, device and model information, app process and state information, available and current audio devices, public playback and recording configuration metadata, plus routing attempts, results, timing and technical events.

App settings dey store locally inside Puzru private app storage. Diagnostic information dey generated and processed for your device, and e fit dey inside di local state of di app as e dey run. Reports no dey save or send by demself. Na only when you clearly choose Save diagnostic report and select where e go save through Android, persistent report go dey created outside Puzru private app storage. After export, na di location or service wey you select—not Puzru—dey control how dem handle, keep and delete that copy.

This current version no dey ask for Android Internet permission, e no get Puzru backend or any network transmission path, and e no include analytics, advert or crash-reporting service or SDK. E no dey currently send diagnostic report give di developer or any Puzru server, so Puzru no get server-side place where e dey keep diagnostic information.

Data wey di app own no dey enter Android cloud backup or device-to-device transfer. Local settings go remain inside private app storage until dem change or dem remove di app data; temporary diagnostic state no be saved report. Exported reports remain under di control of di location or service wey you select.
To select lángwej inside app, you need Android 13 or later. Dis device dey follow system lángwej.
